extracted.intended_audience: prospective grantees, partners, and donors seeking Rockefeller Foundation funding
extracted.subtask_description: Summarizes the Rockefeller Foundation's funding strategy and the types of projects, initiatives, partnerships, and geographic/focus-area priorities they invest in. Useful for applicants and partners aligning proposals to the Foundation's goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tackle climate impacts on vulnerable communities
rubrics_metrics.description: The Foundation has an ambitious whole-of-foundation strategy that is tackling the many ways a shifting climate impacts vulnerable communities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Funding and strategy should address the effects of climate change specifically as they affect vulnerable populations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Improve access to essential services
rubrics_metrics.description: We channel our resources, expertise, and partners into big bets that seek to improve access to electricity, food, health care, economic opportunity, and more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects should demonstrably improve access to basic services such as energy, food, health care, and economic opportunity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identify new solutions
rubrics_metrics.description: We do that by identifying new solutions...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Preference for novel or emergent approaches rather than only well-established interventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Build unlikely partnerships
rubrics_metrics.description: We do that by... building unlikely partnerships...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasis on cross-sector, non-traditional, or strategic partnerships that accelerate impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Track progress toward goals
rubrics_metrics.description: We do that by... tracking progress toward our goals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects should include mechanisms for monitoring, evaluation, and reporting progress against defined goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use grantmaking to transform systems
rubrics_metrics.description: Grantmaking is one of many tools the Foundation uses to transform systems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Funded work should aim for systems-level change rather than only isolated or short-term outputs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initiatives leverage grantee expertise for bold transformation
rubrics_metrics.description: The initiatives we invest in draw on the expertise of our grantees to bring bold, transformative new ideas to life.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Initiatives should be bold and transformative, leveraging grantees' domain expertise to realize new ideas.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form strategic partners and alliances to accelerate impact
rubrics_metrics.description: Meet the special and impactful partnerships we have carefully formed to accelerate our impact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Partnerships should be purposefully structured to speed or scale impact; strategic formation is valued.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support broad, deep, multi-year 'Big Bets'
rubrics_metrics.description: Big Bets: broad, deep, multi-year projects that solve large-scale problems that threaten the well-being of humanity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Preference for long-term, large-scale investments aimed at major global challenges, with depth and sustained commitment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advance sustainable and equitable food systems
rubrics_metrics.description: Food — Advancing food systems that are good for people and planet.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects should promote food systems that are both people-centered (equitable, nutritious) and environmentally sustainable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Address climate-driven global health challenges
rubrics_metrics.description: Health — Addressing the global health emergency of climate change.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work should tackle health impacts that arise or are exacerbated by climate change.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eradicate energy poverty and promote inclusive access
rubrics_metrics.description: Power — Eradicating energy poverty and promoting inclusive access.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Funded efforts should expand access to energy and focus on eliminating energy poverty in inclusive ways.

rubrics_metrics.name: Promote equitable and inclusive U.S. economic opportunity
rubrics_metrics.description: U.S. Economic Opportunity — Working towards an equitable and inclusive economy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects in the U.S. should advance equity and inclusion in economic systems and opportunities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reimagine possibilities through innovation
rubrics_metrics.description: Innovation — Reimagining what is possible to expand human opportunity and solve the world’s most urgent challenges.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports imaginative, potentially paradigm-shifting innovation aimed at expanding human opportunity and addressing urgent problems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Channel private capital for public good via innovative finance
rubrics_metrics.description: Innovative Finance — Channeling private capital for public good.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Preference for financial instruments and models that mobilize private capital to achieve public-benefit outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographic focus areas
rubrics_metrics.description: Where We Work — U.S. and the Americas; Africa; Asia; Italy (The Bellagio Center).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programs and partnerships are focused in these geographies; applicants operating in or targeting these regions align with the Foundation's stated footprint.
